meta.title: Lwert n Qarṭaǧ deg idles
meta.desc: Seg Virgile ɣer Flaubert, seg Purcell ɣer Cabiria, seg Turner ɣer yiwuraren n uvidyu : amek i ddren Didun, Hanibal, Sofonisba akked Salammbô deg tsekla, lopera, taẓwaṛt akked tkatut tatunsit.
hero.title: Lwert n Qarṭaǧ
hero.lede: Ṛuma tehdem tamdint, maca werǧin tḥebbes ad temmeslay fell-as. Didun, Hanibal, Sofonisba akked Salammbô zegren tiqsiṭin tilatiniyin, lopera abaṛuk, taẓwaṛt tarumantikt, apeplum akked yiwuraren n uvidyu — di Tunisia, Qarṭaǧ teqqim d isem n yal ass.
hero.alt: Didun tebna Qarṭaǧ, sɣur J. M. W. Turner
hero.caption: J. M. W. Turner, Didun tebna Qarṭaǧ (1815) — National Gallery, Londres
keys.0.t: ccɛeṛ deg Punica n Silius Italicus, aẓawan alatini iɣezfen akteṛ yeqqimen
keys.1.t: Purcell yecɣel Didun deg Dido and Aeneas
keys.3.t: Cabiria, apeplum ameqqran amezwaru deg umezruy n ssinima
filter.label: Fren tigezmiyin s wammas
lit.title: Seg tiqsiṭ ɣer wungal
lit.aside: Imeskaren ilatiniyen snulfan-d Qarṭaǧ n tmacahut ; imaynuten snulfan-tt-id daɣen s tarrayt-nsen.
lit.frise.title: Qarṭaǧ s ucuban
lit.frise.rows.0.title: Naevius, Bellum Punicum
lit.frise.rows.0.text: Aɛeskri aqbur n umenɣi apunik amezwaru, ameskar yessufeɣ-d seg-s tiqsiṭ talatinit tamezwarut ɣef tɣawsa n umezruy ; ur d-yeqqim ara ala ucerreg.
lit.frise.rows.1.title: Plaute, Poenulus
lit.frise.rows.1.text: « Aqarṭaǧi Amecṭuḥ » : amsezzenz Hanun yemmeslay dinna tapunikt — ucerreg iɣezfen akteṛ n tutlayt-agi i yeqqimen deg tsekla talatinit.
lit.frise.rows.2.title: Virgile, Énéide
lit.frise.rows.2.text: Didun, i yeǧǧa Enya, tenɛal dderya-s tessawel amenkar : tamacahut i d-yesnulfan lkeṛh ger Ṛuma d Qarṭaǧ.
lit.frise.rows.3.title: Ovide, Héroïdes, VII
lit.frise.rows.3.text: Tabrat n Didun i Enya, yettwaru uqbel tmettant-is.
lit.frise.rows.4.title: Silius Italicus, Punica
lit.frise.rows.4.text: Amenɣi apunik wis sin deg 17 n yiccɛaren, seg Sagonte armi d Zama.
lit.frise.rows.5.title: Augustin, Confessions
lit.frise.rows.5.text: Lmeqdem n Hippone, i yeɣran di Qarṭaǧ, yeqqar-d belli yerḍil, d aḥdiq, ɣef tmettant n Didun (I, 13).
lit.frise.rows.6.title: Pétrarque, Africa
lit.frise.rows.6.text: Tiqsiṭ talatinit s ucaraf n Scipion, teqqim war tifukt ; tefka afus ad yettwaɛellaq umeskar ɣer Capitole deg 1341.
lit.frise.rows.7.title: Marlowe, Dido, Queen of Carthage
lit.frise.rows.7.text: Tagellidt tekcem ɣer tẓẓili n zzman Elisabeth.
lit.frise.rows.8.title: Flaubert, Salammbô
lit.frise.rows.8.text: Ungal i yesresen azal n lqern tugna n Qarṭaǧ taɛezrit tuqsiḥt.
lit.figAlt: Enya iḥekku i Didun lmihanat n Tṛuya, sɣur Pierre-Narcisse Guérin
lit.figCap: Pierre-Narcisse Guérin, Enya iḥekku i Didun lmihanat n Tṛuya (1815) — asinag n Louvre
lit.tiles.0.title: Didun, seg tasersayt ɣer tečriḥt
lit.tiles.0.text: Ɣer Timée d Justin, Elisa tegr iman-is deg lmut iwakken ad teffeg zzwaǧ yettwaḥettmen ; Virgile yegg-itt d tečriḥt n Enya. Talɣa-agi taṛumanit, i d-yeqbel Ovide imbeɛd lopera, teḥbes aṭas lweqt tugna n tasersayt.
lit.tiles.1.title: Hanibal, aɛeggal n tiqsiṭ
lit.tiles.1.text: Akunsul deg 68, Silius Italicus yefka tuɣalin-is i tiqsiṭ n ugar n 12 000 n yisefra, anida Hanibal d amsenfaṛ yemcum. Ițwattu deg leqrun agensan, yettwaf-d azal n 1417 sɣur umesnilem Poggio Bracciolini.
lit.tiles.2.title: Sofonisba, tagellidt n tečriḥt
lit.tiles.2.text: Trissino (1515), Mairet (1634), Corneille (1663), Voltaire (1770) : tagellidt taqarṭaǧit i yextaren aẓiḏi ɣef triyunf n Scipion d yiwet seg tɣawsiwin timeqqranin n tečriḥt n Turuft.
lit.flaubert.title: Salammbô, Qarṭaǧ n wargu
lit.flaubert.paras.0: Mbeɛd asteεfu di Tunes akked Qarṭaǧ di tafsut n 1858, Flaubert yesres ungal-is deg umennuɣ n Iɛeskriyen Uqeṛḍasen (241–237 send Ɛisa), yeḍfeṛ Polybe s telqey. Taneḍmant-is, yelli-s n Hamilkar d takahint n Tanit, tekka-d seg tmeẓẓugt-is.
lit.flaubert.paras.1: Adlis-agi yesnulfa aṭas n yisallen : yesnulfa lopera, taẓwaṛt n Ccerq, Art nouveau, ssinima tasusmit — armi d isem n ugraw deg Qarṭaǧ n wass-a.
lit.flaubert.alt: Salammbô s uqendur azegzaw d ddheb, aquarelle n Rochegrosse
lit.flaubert.caption: Georges Rochegrosse, Salammbô, aquarelle i tira yettwaɣzan n 1900
scene.title: Didun tɛeǧǧeb
scene.aside: Seg lopera abaṛuk, tagellidt n Qarṭaǧ d yiwet seg tɣawsiwin timeqqranin tiqsiḥin ; Salammbô tedda yid-s deg lqern wis 19.
scene.frise.title: Ɣef iḍwaren n lopera
scene.frise.rows.0.title: Cavalli, La Didone
scene.frise.rows.0.text: Yettwaxdem di Venise s wedlis n Busenello : yiwet seg lopera timezwura i yettwacudden i tgellidt.
scene.frise.rows.1.title: Purcell, Dido and Aeneas
scene.frise.rows.1.text: Adlis n Nahum Tate, yettwaxdem deg uɣerbaz n tullas n Chelsea. Lamento « When I am laid in earth » d yiwen seg isɣunan ițwassnen akteṛ n zzman abaṛuk.
scene.frise.rows.2.title: Métastase, Didone abbandonata
scene.frise.rows.2.text: Yettwaxdem di Naples s wezɣal n Domenico Sarro, adlis-agi ɣur-s aẓawan n waṭas n yimeskaren deg lqern wis 18.
scene.frise.rows.3.title: Gluck, Sofonisba
scene.frise.rows.3.text: Yettwaxdem di Milan : Sofonisba tɛeddi seg tečriḥt ɣer lopera.
scene.frise.rows.4.title: Berlioz, Les Troyens
scene.frise.rows.4.text: Yettwabna ɣef Virgile ; amur wis sin kan, « Les Troyens à Carthage », i yețwaskanen deg tudert n Berlioz. Lxedma meṛṛa teḍhiṛ-d kan deg 1890, di Karlsruhe.
scene.frise.rows.5.title: Moussorgski, Salammbô
scene.frise.rows.5.text: Lopera ur yefruri ara ɣef Flaubert ; ameskar yeqbal isebtar-ines deg Boris Godounov.
scene.frise.rows.6.title: Reyer, Salammbô
scene.frise.rows.6.text: Yettwaxdem deg ṭṭiyaṭru n la Monnaie, di Bruxelles, imbeɛd deg Lopera n Paris deg 1892.
scene.quote.tr: « Cfu fell-i, maca a! ṭṭu lqedeṛ-iw. »
scene.quote.cite: Nahum Tate, adlis n Dido and Aeneas
scene.berlioz.title: Didun twala Hanibal i d-yettasen
scene.berlioz.text: Ɣef times-is, Didun n Berlioz twala tugna n umenkar, Hanibal, uqbel ad twali triyunf n Ṛuma : lopera-agi tesskan-d tiɣlel n Énéide (IV, 625).
art.title: Qarṭaǧ s uẓwaɣ
art.aside: Seg ubaṛuk n Venise ɣer Art nouveau, ismeslayen akteṛ i ṭṭfen imeẓẓuɣaren d taẓwaṛt n limin, tuffra d tmettanin.
art.feat.title: Hanibal yesekken aqerru n Hasdrubal
art.feat.paras.0: Deg 207 send Ɛisa, mbeɛd aɣelli n Métaure, akunsul Claudius Néron yegr aqerru n Hasdrubal zdat yimukan n lḥers n gma-s (Tite-Live, XXVII, 51).
art.feat.paras.1: Tiepolo yeẓwaɣ asenkez n Hanibal yettwaḥuddun i wezgen n umezruy aṛumani i yettwasersen i uxxam n Dolfin, di Venise. Qarṭaǧ tuɣal dinna d tɣawsa n taẓwaṛt tameqqrant n umezruy, am Ṛuma.
art.feat.latTr: « Ẓriɣ dinna lqedeṛ n Qarṭaǧ » — awalen i Tite-Live yefka i Hanibal zdat n uqerru n gma-s.
art.feat.alt: Hanibal yesenkez zdat n uqerru yettwagezmen n gma-s Hasdrubal, sɣur Tiepolo
art.feat.caption: G. B. Tiepolo — Kunsthistorisches Museum, Vienne
art.items.0.alt: Tamettant n Sofonisba, sɣur Mattia Preti
art.items.0.title: Tamettant n Sofonisba
art.items.0.text: Akufi n uẓiḏi i d-yuzen Masinisa : tɣawsa yesmenyafen imeẓẓuɣaren abaṛuk.
art.items.1.alt: Limin n Hanibal, sɣur Benjamin West
art.items.1.title: Limin n Hanibal
art.items.1.text: D aqcic, Hanibal yegall zdat baba-s Hamilkar ur ad yili d amddakel n Ṛuma (Polybe, III, 11 ; Tite-Live, XXI, 1).
art.items.2.alt: Hanibal yetturar i Italya seg Idurar n Alpes, sɣur Goya
art.items.2.title: Hanibal yenɛem yetturar i Italya
art.items.2.text: Yeẓwaɣ-it di Italya umeẓyan Goya i teɣnit n Académie n Parme : Hanibal yettwali tigzirt seg wedrar n Alpes.
art.items.3.alt: Tuffra n udfel : Hanibal akked lɛesker-is yezegren Idurar n Alpes, sɣur Turner
art.items.3.title: Tuffra n udfel : Hanibal yezger Idurar n Alpes
art.items.3.text: Tuffra n udfel teqrib tesseɣli lɛesker akk : Turner yegg Hanibal d tɣawsa tarumantikt, deg Turuft yettwaḥekkmen sɣur Napoléon. (Tate, Londres)
art.items.4.title: Salammbô
art.items.4.text: Lithographie Art nouveau : takahint n Tanit i d-yesnulfa Flaubert, ger lharp d usɣuy n lebxur, tuɣal d lemtel n uẓwaɣ.
art.also.title: Tɣawsa i yezegren leqrun
art.also.items.0: Turner yeẓwaɣ timɣurt d uɣelli : Didun tebna Qarṭaǧ (1815) imbeɛd Aɣelli n tgelda taqarṭaǧit (1817), ɣren-ten aṭas d aɛlam i Tgelda n Tabrixt. Yegr-it-id i National Gallery s ma yettwaɛlleq qrib n win n Claude Lorrain.
art.also.items.1: David yegzem isem n Hanibal ɣef uzru, ddaw n win n Bonaparte, deg Bonaparte yezger Agran-Saint-Bernard (1801).
art.also.items.2: Guérin (1815) akked Rochegrosse (1900), nnig deg usebter-agi, snaẓwaɣen Virgile akked Flaubert.
cine.title: Qarṭaǧ ɣef ucenfiṛ
cine.aside: Apeplum aṭalyan yegg Qarṭaǧ d amḍiq n tmacahut — akked lemri n tirmit n Italya tamaynut.
cine.cabiria.title: Cabiria
cine.cabiria.paras.0: Yettwaxdem sɣur Giovanni Pastrone, Cabiria yeḍfeṛ taqcict tasiciliyant yettwakksen, yettwazenzen i Qarṭaǧ tettwagall ad tettwaseflen di lǥameɛ n « Moloch », ɣef lǥerḥ n umenɣi apunik wis sin : tizgart n Hanibal n Idurar n Alpes, aḥeṛṣ n Syracuse d lemrayat n Archimède, tadyant n Sofonisba.
cine.cabiria.paras.1: Qrib krad n yisragen, lemtul imeqqranen, tizgariwin tiɣezfanin : Cabiria d apeplum ameqqran amezwaru, yesnjam D. W. Griffith i Intolerance (1916). Tḥilat-is n usfel qeṛṛbent akteṛ ɣer Salammbô wala ɣer yiɣbula iqdimen.
cine.cabiria.facts.1.v: Gabriele D'Annunzio, i d-yefkan daɣen ismawen i Cabiria akked Maciste
cine.cabiria.facts.2.v: Amɣar yesnulfa Bartolomeo Pagano, aqeddac aqbur n Gênes, yuɣal d aneḍmant n tnac n ifilmen
cine.cabiria.cta: Ayen i d-qqaren s tidet iɣbula ɣef tofet
cine.cabiria.alt: Lǥafit n Cabiria sɣur Leopoldo Metlicovitz : taqcict tettwali nnig n times
cine.cabiria.caption: Leopoldo Metlicovitz, lǥafit n Cabiria (1914)
cine.frise.title: Seg ssinima tasusmit ɣer peplum
cine.frise.rows.0.title: Salammbô
cine.frise.rows.0.text: Pierre Marodon yesnjam Flaubert ; aẓawan n Florent Schmitt.
cine.frise.rows.1.title: Scipione l'Africano
cine.frise.rows.1.text: Afilm n tiɛmert n ufaciste, yettwaxdem sɣur Carmine Gallone : tanyafit n Ṛuma deg Zama tesskan-d lemqasad n uṭṭef n Ethiopia.
cine.frise.rows.2.title: Annibale
cine.frise.rows.2.text: Victor Mature yecɣel Hanibal deg peplum-agi n Edgar G. Ulmer akked Carlo Ludovico Bragaglia, s tizgart n Idurar n Alpes ɣef udar n ulfil.
cine.frise.rows.3.title: Cartagine in fiamme
cine.frise.rows.3.text: Carmine Gallone yesnjam ungal n Emilio Salgari, ɣef lǥerḥ n umenɣi apunik wis krad.
cine.frise.rows.4.title: Salambò
cine.frise.rows.4.text: Asnjam amaynut n Flaubert sɣur Sergio Grieco, akked Jeanne Valérie.
cine.frise.rows.5.title: Hannibal (BBC)
cine.frise.rows.5.text: Afilm-tissɣunin anida Alexander Siddig yecɣel Hanibal, qrib ɣer tiqsiḥin n Polybe d Tite-Live.
cine.doc.title: Seg lxrab ɣer ucenfiṛ
cine.doc.paras.0: Idisumantiren imaynuten bennun ɣef tsenfarrut — lebḥura izirar, tofet, agraw apuni n Byrsa — iwakken ad ffɣen seg tugna n peplum.
cine.doc.paras.1: Yeqqim uɣawas : aḥekku n Qarṭaǧ seg igar-is s yiman-is, mačči kan seg tiqsiḥin n yimerbaḥ-is.
play.title: Deg tgejdal akked lpiksilat
play.aside: Tabdart n yineggafen (BD), yiwuraren n uvidyu, yiwuraren n tbelleṭ : Hanibal yeqqim d anezwi i yebɣan meṛṛa ad cuban.
play.items.0.title: Alix, Druillet
play.items.0.rows.0.v: Jacques Martin yettazzen aɛeggal-is agalo-aṛumani ɣer Lḥif n Qarṭaǧ, aktab n tsuqilt Alix.
play.items.0.rows.1.v: Philippe Druillet yettawi Salammbô ɣer igenwan, akked uɛeggal-is Lone Sloane, deg krad n yiktaben.
play.items.1.title: Tirrategin tiqdimin
play.items.1.rows.0.v: Qarṭaǧ tezmer ad tettwecɣel deg waṭas n iḥricen, aṭas lweqt s tugna n Hanibal ; Didun tḥekkem-itt deg Civilization V, imbeɛd tezgi Tefniqt deg Civilization VI.
play.items.1.rows.1.v: Iqarṭaǧiyen țțasen-d akked usiweḍ The Rise of Rome (1998).
play.items.1.rows.2.v: Qarṭaǧ d yiwet seg tarbaɛt yezmer ad tettwecɣel deg Rome: Total War (2004) akked Total War: Rome II (2013), anida teklal Hannibal at the Gates (2014) tḥekku amenɣi apunik wis sin.
play.items.2.rows.0.v: Awuraren n usmazi n Mark Simonitch yesnulfan amenɣi apunik wis sin, seg Idurar n Alpes armi d Zama. Yal amkan, yiwet n tsestent : Hanibal izmer ad yenɣelb ?
tn.title: Isem n yal ass
tn.aside: Di Tunisia, Qarṭaǧ mačči d asmekti n yimusnawen kan : d isem n ugraw, n webrid, n ssnita n ttiliẓyu.
tn.rows.0.val: Hanibal akked Elisa banen ɣef idrimen n Lbanka Tagejdant n Tunisia ; Lbusṭa Tatunsit tezga tefka asekkil i yimukan akked yidmawen imeqqranen n Qarṭaǧ.
tn.rows.1.val: Di Qarṭaǧ, igrawen d yimukan n TGM semman-asen Hanibal, Amilcar akked Salammbô — isem-agi aneggaru, i d-yesnulfa Flaubert, yettwaseqdac ass-a i ugraw yellan s tidet, qrib lebḥura ipuniyen.
tn.rows.2.val: Abrid n Qarṭaǧ yezger ammas n Tunes ; deg tmurt meṛṛa, iberdan, iɣerbazen d lmaɣazat ɣefsen ismawen n Hanibal, Hamilkar neɣ Elisa.
tn.rows.3.val: Hannibal TV, i yeldin deg 2005, tella d ssnita tamezwarut n ttiliẓyu udmasan n tmurt.
tn.rows.4.val: Ineddawen n Ṛuma akked Qarṭaǧ gran lemɛahda n lemtel i yesekkṛen amenɣi apunik wis krad.
tn.emblem.title: Seg Igedwan ɣer tesuɣyin
tn.emblem.text: Axxam alḥakimi, amersa, Ussan Isinimatugrafiyen akked Tesuɣit Tagraɣlant n Qarṭaǧ, « Igedwan n Qarṭaǧ » n tarbaɛt taɣelnawt n ddecra n uḍar : isem n temdint tapunit yuɣal d win n Tunisia i d-yesseknen i ddunit.
words.title: Qarṭaǧ deg tutlayt
words.aside: Timeslayin ɛeddant ɣer useqdec — s telqey i d-yesnulfa Ṛuma, aɛdaw.
words.items.0.mean: « Hanibal ɣer tewwura » : asekken aglaɣi ameqqran.
words.items.0.text: Timeslayt-agi, tettwassen sɣur Cicéron (Philippiques, I, 11), teḥrez asmekti n tugdi n 211 send Ɛisa, mi Hanibal yeddu ɣer Ṛuma. Tite-Live yura « ante portas ».
words.items.1.text: Akken i d-yeqqar Plutarque, Caton Amɣar yesmed yal ṛṛay-is deg Ssenaṭ s ssuter-agi ; timeslayt talatinit ițwassnen d asnulfu aneggaru akteṛ.
words.items.2.mean: « Laman apunik », yebɣa ad yini lexdeɛ.
words.items.2.text: Azwel n ucehhal aṛumani, i d-yeqbel Salluste akked Tite-Live, yefka i Hanibal « lexdeɛ ugar n win apunik ». Ṛuma, maca, ur teḥrez ara abeda awal-is.
words.items.3.mean: Lɛawan i yessedhiwinen i d-yesseɣli lmeqyas.
words.items.3.text: Awal-agi yekka-d seg Tite-Live (XXIII, 18) : ccetwa n 216–215 send Ɛisa deg Capoue yesserɣi aɛesskar n Hanibal. Imesnezruyen imaynuten smiden aṭas ṛṛay-agi.
words.items.4.text: Keynes yesnejma awal-agi deg 1919, deg Igmaḏ idamsanen n talwit, iwakken ad yenker lemɛahda n Versailles.
words.items.5.text: Tanyafit n Hanibal deg 216 send Ɛisa tuɣal d isem amagnu n umenɣi n uhlak ikemlen ; anezwi aleman Schlieffen yegg-itt d lemtel.
words.topo.title: Qarṭaǧat ɣef tkarṭa meṛṛa
words.topo.text: Carthagène, i yesres At Barka s yisem n Qart-Ḥadašt ; Cartagena de Indias, di Colombie, i d-yekka isem-is seg temdint n Hispanya ; Hannibal, di Missouri, akked ugar n mraw n timdinin timirikaniyin yettwasemmayen Carthage.
